tb199-s445-0.shows: A flowchart for identifying metal cations by adding sodium hydroxide solution. It first asks whether the precipitate is coloured. If yes, it asks which colour: grey-green gives Cr3+, green gives Fe2+, brown gives Fe3+, light blue gives Cu2+. Cr3+ and Fe2+ go on to adding excess sodium hydroxide; if the precipitate dissolves it is Cr3+, if not it is Fe2+. If the precipitate is not coloured, excess sodium hydroxide is added. If it does not redissolve the ion is Cu2+; if it does, the ion is Al3+ or Zn2+, and the test is repeated with ammonia solution. If that precipitate dissolves in excess the ion is Zn2+; if not, Al3+.
